# Regionshospitalet Horsens

Regionshospitalet Horsens is a Danish hospital providing specialized treatment for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) as part of the national DANIBD registry. Between October 2023 and September 2024, the hospital treated 386 patients receiving biological drug therapy (BMSL treatment), with 241 patients (62%) diagnosed with Crohn's disease and 145 patients (38%) with ulcerative colitis [^src1]. These patient numbers and diagnoses were documented in the DANIBD national registry during this period, reflecting the hospital's role in managing both major forms of IBD across a significant patient population.

The treatment data from Regionshospitalet Horsens contributes to a broader national picture of IBD care in Denmark documented in the DANIBD registry. This registry tracks patient characteristics, biological drug treatment patterns, surgical interventions, and comorbid conditions such as primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) among both pediatric and adult patients across Danish hospitals and treatment centers [^src1].
